steps.npc: Please only talk to the King if it's important. He has a heavy burden to bear with the running of his kingdom.
Apologies! Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Aeonisig Raispher, special advisor to King Roald on spiritual matters.

steps.player: Special advisor on spiritual matters? What does that mean?

steps.npc: It means that some decisions the King has to make might have unforeseen repercussions on Misthalin's spiritual sensibilities. My duty is to ensure that Saradominist ideals are not stomped underfoot.
My main function is to ensure that King Roald is apprised of all options, especially when it comes to any potential impacts on the righteous followers of Saradomin.

steps.player: But surely the King should be able to make his own decisions on what's best for Misthalin?

steps.npc: What an interesting perspective you have! Totally unworkable of course, but interesting nonetheless.
I took my religious and combat training in several parts of the known world. I've also fought despicable beasts in the Wilderness in Saradomin's name.
Needless to say, I have great experience in the ways of the world and am an invaluable aid to the King's decision-making process.

options.text: How did you come to be an advisor to King Roald?

steps.player: How did you come to be an advisor to King Roald?

steps.npc: The King of Misthalin, like any great leader, always requires the best advice and the best advisors.
He very often summons occasional advisors to help him in certain situations, but it was felt by the Church of Saradomin that a full time advisor on religious matters was needed.

steps.player: How come he doesn't have an advisor for any other religious denominations?

steps.npc: Other religious denominations? The ruling of a kingdom is no place for pagan cults and their intolerable beliefs! We do things properly here, thank you very much.
